definitions.definition: (broadly) The state of being precise or exact; especially, both exact and accurate.
(strictly) The ability of a measurement to be reproduced consistently.
(mathematics) The number of significant digits to which a value may be measured reliably.
(bridge) A bidding system that makes use of many artificial bids to describe a hand quite precisely.
Used for exact or precise measurement.

quote.citation: 2011 October 1, John Sinnott, “Aston Villa 2 - 0 Wigan”, in BBC Sport‎[1]:
quote.text: But there was nothing he could do about Villa's second when Agbonlahor crossed from the left and Bent finished with a precision volley.
